name: MSI GPU MUX
author: Raul Dias
description: Switch the hardware GPU MUX of supported MSI laptops (Discrete, MSHybrid, Integrated) from the Omarchy bar, through msi-mux-switch and the shell's polkit prompt. Shows the current and the staged mode, and in MSHybrid can choose the GPU Hyprland composites on.

barWidget.description: GPU icon showing the current MUX mode, with a badge while a switch waits for a full shutdown; click for the three modes, the AC state and, in MSHybrid, Hyprland's base GPU. Hidden on non-MSI hardware.

schema.label: msi-mux-switch path
schema.description: Absolute path to the msi-mux-switch binary. Empty: /usr/bin/msi-mux-switch (the msi-gpu-mux-switch package) if anything is there, else /opt/msi-mux-switch/msi-mux-switch; a path set here is always the one used. The plugin only switches when this file and every directory above it are owned by root and not writable by group or others; for a binary outside /usr/bin, Set up backend in the panel fixes the file and its folder.

schema.label: Warn about external screens before Integrated
schema.description: Adds the external-screen warning to the confirmation before staging Integrated (the external outputs are wired to the RTX GPU and probably stay dark).
